footer.about: A community-driven cybersecurity intelligence network helping citizens across India verify suspicious phone numbers, UPI handles, bank accounts, and fraudulent websites.
footer.subtext: Dedicated to proactive cyber fraud prevention across Indian communities.
footer.govPortal: Official Government of India Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
footer.privacyNotice: Privacy-First Architecture: Personal reporter identities and pinpoint coordinates are never disclosed. All map coordinates are aggregated at area level.
footer.copyright: Community Scam Map. Built for citizen awareness in India.

home.badge: India Citizen Cyber Fraud Intelligence Network
home.subtitle: Check suspicious numbers, UPI IDs and links. Report scams and help protect your community through shared awareness.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Crowdsourced cyber intelligence verified through automated heuristics to protect everyday digital transactions.
home.safetyTipsSubtitle: Simple habits to protect yourself and your family from evolving digital scams.
home.emergencySubtitle: If you or someone you know has lost funds to cyber fraud, take action within the golden hour.
home.quickActionsSubtitle: Direct tools to verify suspected cyber fraud, submit intel, and monitor regional threats.
home.qaCheckDesc: Check whether a phone number, UPI ID, URL or SMS sender ID has been reported.
home.qaReportDesc: Help others by reporting suspicious identifiers and fraudulent transactions.
home.qaMapDesc: Discover reported scam activity and geographic risk clusters across areas.
home.qaAlertsDesc: Stay informed about emerging scam patterns, fake APKs, and phishing campaigns.
home.emergencyDesc: If you have just sent money to a scammer, act quickly. Filing a complaint immediately with the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal activates banking lien protocols to freeze unauthorized transactions.
home.goldenHour: Golden Hour: Report within 2-3 hours of an incident for the highest fund recovery chance.

lookup.title: Check Before You Trust
lookup.subtitle: Check suspicious numbers, payment IDs and links before interacting or making a payment.
lookup.searchingDesc: Checking reported numbers, UPI IDs, and verified registries.
lookup.emptyPrompt: Enter an Identifier to Run Verification
lookup.emptyDesc: Verify suspect callers, UPI payment QR handles, suspicious SMS headers, or phishing URLs against thousands of community fraud reports across India.
lookup.stayAlertDesc: Fraudsters frequently rotate accounts, phone numbers, and domains to evade detection.

report.title: Report a Scam
report.subtitle: Submit a suspicious phone number, UPI ID, website, or SMS sender ID to help protect thousands of people across India.
report.abuseNotice: This form is for reporting suspected fraud only. Misuse, spam, or false reports may result in restricted access. All submissions are reviewed before being made public.
report.step1Desc: Select the type of suspicious contact and enter its value.
report.step2Desc: What type of scam was it and what happened?
report.step3Desc: Your area helps map scam hotspots and alert nearby citizens. We do not store your exact address or home location.
report.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Received call asking for OTP claiming to be SBI
report.descPlaceholder: Describe what happened. Do not include your OTP, passwords, PIN, or full bank account numbers.
report.privacyP1: Your identity as a reporter is not displayed publicly.
report.privacyP2: Scam reports are shared to protect the community, not to expose individuals.
report.privacyP3: Map visualisation uses area-level aggregation, not exact addresses.
report.privacyP4: Do not include OTPs, passwords, PINs, or full bank account numbers in your description.
report.successDesc: Thank you for helping protect the community. Your report has been received and will be reviewed by the intelligence network.

map.title: Community Scam Map
map.subtitle: Visualizing aggregated scam activity across areas over the past 7 days. This map helps citizens and small businesses identify emerging local scam trends to stay vigilant against fraudulent calls, messages, and links.
map.disclaimerDesc: Incident clusters represent aggregated reports received by our community safety network over the past seven days. Reports do not indicate or imply that an entire locality, neighborhood, or merchant community is fraudulent. Exact reporter locations, addresses, and individual identities are never exposed.
map.selectArea: Select an Area on the Map
map.selectAreaDesc: Click any marker or cluster to inspect 7-day incident volume and top scam patterns.

alerts.title: Community Scam Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Alerts highlight notable shifts in community scam reports across monitored areas. They reflect localized reporting spikes and newly emerging scam categories, helping citizens stay ahead of evolving fraud campaigns.
alerts.guideDesc: To prevent alarm fatigue, alerts fire only when unusual activity is detected by our trust rules, never for routine individual reports:
alerts.spikeDesc: Triggered when verified reports in an area over 24 hours at least double the prior 7-day daily baseline (minimum 5 reports).
alerts.newTypeDesc: Triggered when a scam pattern is reported in an area that was not seen in that locality during the preceding 30 days.

disputes.title: Business Report Dispute
disputes.subtitle: If you represent a business and believe a community scam report is incorrect, you can submit a challenge for review.
disputes.guideDesc: The Community Scam Map is designed to protect citizens from financial fraud while ensuring that legitimate local shops, businesses, and service providers are protected from wrongful or competitor report-bombing.
disputes.step1Desc: Provide your trade name, official contact email, and official registration details (e.g. GSTIN, Shop License, or MSME registration).
disputes.step2Desc: Once registered, the identifier enters an 'under review' status. Public lookups display challenged rather than a confirmed scam verdict.
disputes.step3Desc: A challenge is a request for review, not an automatic removal. Genuine victim warnings are balanced against verified credentials.
disputes.formStep1Desc: Select the contact channel and enter the exact number, UPI handle, website link, or SMS header being disputed.
disputes.formStep2Desc: Provide your official business identity and an authorized representative email address.
disputes.formStep3Desc: Describe your verifiable business registrations to support your dispute.
